content: Direct induction route: for n>=2 apply column replacements j=n,n-1,...,2, replacing column j by column j minus x_1 times column j-1. Descending order ensures both columns used have their original monomial entries. The first row becomes (1,0,...,0); expansion and factoring x_i-x_1 from rows i=2,...,n reduce to the (n-1)-variable Vandermonde determinant. This avoids division and therefore covers repeated x_i.
